item.description:

I already know that whatever you choose to do in this life, you’re going to do incredible things.

item.description:
Coming into 2026, I wanted to step into something that felt aligned with this season of my life something creative, flexible, and built around what I truly love.

Cooking has always been my love language. Creating meals, hosting, bringing people together it’s never felt like work to me.

So I turned it into something more.

Introducing @gentlyserved a Los Angeles–based catering company.

The first month has stretched me in every way , long days, a few tears, and a lot of learning but also more fulfillment than I ever expected.

This is just the beginning, and I’m so excited for what’s ahead.

item.title: Nothing better than coming home, slipping into your robe, and cooking a homemade meal🍴✨🍛
item.description:
Nothing better than coming home, slipping into your robe, and cooking a homemade meal🍴✨🍛

Salmon Curry 🤍 (so simple, so good)

Start by marinating your salmon with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and curry powder (about 1 tbsp of each).

Finely chop 2 bell peppers and 1 onion and set aside.

Sear the salmon until lightly golden, then remove from the pan.

In the same pan, add 2 tbsp curry powder along with the peppers and onion. Sauté until soft and fragrant.

Add in thyme, minced garlic, and ginger — cook for another minute.

Pour in coconut milk and season with salt, garlic powder, and a little cayenne for heat.

Place the salmon back into the sauce, cover, and let it simmer for 15 minutes.

Finish with rice, fresh cilantro and a squeeze of lime 🤍

🎵 Worst Way - Riley Green

item.title: Cosy days at home mean one thing in our kitchen, home-cooked meals. Yesterday I made one of Cairo’s favorites,
item.description:
Cosy days at home mean one thing in our kitchen, home-cooked meals. Yesterday I made one of Cairo’s favorites,
Sweet Potato Pizza 🍕

Ingredients
•Sweet potatoes
•Flour of choice (I used whole wheat)
•Tomato paste
•Cheese
•Cherry tomatoes
•Sliced deli meat (I used chicken breast)
•Olives
•Oregano
Instructions
1.Peel and cut your sweet potatoes, then boil until fork-tender.
2.Mash well and gradually add flour, kneading as you go until a soft dough forms.
3.Lightly spray a baking tray with avocado oil.
4.Press the dough into mini pizza circles on the tray.
5.Spread tomato paste over each base, then sprinkle cheese.
6.Add your toppings—cherry tomatoes, chicken breast slices, olives, etc.
7.Finish with a sprinkle of oregano.
8.Bake at 350°F for 15–20 minutes, keeping an eye on them as cook time may vary depending on the size and thickness.

#sweetpotatopizza #blw #blwrecipes #babyrecipes #GentleBites

item.title: Made my daughter’s first birthday cake from scratch 🍰💖 A naturally sweet banana cake with whipped cream, cream cheese, maple syrup & strawberry...
item.description:
Made my daughter’s first birthday cake from scratch 🍰💖 A naturally sweet banana cake with whipped cream, cream cheese, maple syrup & strawberry frosting — Simple & wholesome!
Save this recipe for your next baby friendly bake 🎂✨

Cake 🍌:
•4 Bananas
•1 cup of your choice of flour (I used whole wheat)
•A splash of alcohol-free vanilla extract
•1 Tbsp self-raising flour
•¼ cup melted butter 🧈
•1 tsp cinnamon

Frosting 🍓:
•Heavy whipping cream
•2 tsp cream cheese
•A splash of maple syrup
•5 smashed strawberries
